question: By what order is the infinity of difference now to be reckoned?
premises: The endlessness of difference has been set forth concisely and at length.
What follows is its sequential reckoning beginning with the water-principle.
The marker moreover signals a new movement from exposition to enumeration.
inference: The verse closes the bheda-infinity exposition and opens the ordered reckoning of divisions from water upward.
uncertainties: Scope of root-to-end left open between tattva series and adhvan stations.
Why water rather than earth opens the series, earth perhaps treated in the preceding kanda.
plain_english: The boundless manifold of difference, treated in brief and in full, is set forth; and now, in due order, comes the reckoning of its divisions from water onward, from root to end.
